Jane —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. Attached is a single package with the current subprocessor roster and the specific evidence items you requested. Highlights below so your Risk Committee has a short summary: 

- Vendor roster: comprehensive list of subprocessors and their processing roles + region tags (US/EU/APAC).
- Planned change: we intend to consolidate long-term cold backup storage from CloudNode to TierSafe (Q1 2027). This affects encrypted object storage used for backups only; primary inference runtime remains on our current GPU provider fleet and will not move.
- Reason: TierSafe provides a consolidated, compliance-ready cold storage product which reduces cross-provider replication complexity.
- Risk mitigations: full encryption at rest, customer-segmented buckets, dedicated IAM roles, and documented rollback plan. We will not migrate live inference data or KV caches — backups only.

Attachments included: redwood_subprocessor_evidence_20261216.pdf (roster + vendor roles), cloudnode-transition-plan-20261215.docx (high level transition intent).

If it helps, Vanessa can add a short operations note on region failover and the fallback playbook.

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Quick operational note to supplement Sean's overview:

- Scope of change: CloudNode -> TierSafe applies only to cold backup retention buckets (S3-compatible). No compute, model weights, or inference response flows are impacted.
- Data residency: backups will remain in the same regions they were created (we will request TierSafe to provision in the same US region; EU/ APAC remain unchanged).
- Timeline: planning and vendor onboarding Jan 2027; non-production syncs Feb; final cutover window Mar (subject to customer opt-out windows).
- Audit evidence: we will provide updated KMS configuration snapshots and the TierSafe subprocessor contract excerpt before any cutover window is scheduled with customers.

For Acme specifically, we can opt for a delayed opt-in until after your Risk Committee completes review — we will treat Acme as a manual opt-in by default.
